d:
Rockstar (2011) is a musical romantic drama about Janardhan Jakhar, a simple Delhi boy who transforms into the rebellious rockstar Jordan. Driven by heartbreak and personal tragedy, he discovers that true art is born from deep suffering, resulting in an unforgettable journey of love and fame.
Rokastar (2011) janardan jakhar ki ek myujikal drama philm hai, jo dilli ka ek sadharan larka hai aur bad men bagi rokastar 'jordan' ban jata hai. tute dil aur dard se gujarte hue, vah samajhta hai ki sachchi kala gahre dard se janm leti hai.
